title: Drag-and-Drop Placement: Balancing Manual Yield Gaps and Offline Rewards
subtitle: A deep dive into the numerical logic of drag-and-drop placement mechanics. By comparing manual yield gaps with offline reward formulas, we derive a balancing equation to curb excessive manual play. The guide covers cap setting, anti-farming mechanisms, and reward curve design, offering actionable solutions to the 'tiring when active, losing out when idle' player pain point.
